title: Google experiments with an AI-powered gaming platform
hook_text: Google just built a game creator
script:
Google Labs just launched a platform called Playground.
It lets you build browser-based games using simple text prompts.
You do not need any coding experience to make them.
You can play your creations instantly right inside your web browser.
Would you use it to make your own game?
